items.description: Nakhon Ratchasima is the capital of Nakhon Ratchasima province, the largest city in Northeastern Thailand and the third-largest city in Thailand. It is 250 kilometres northeast of Bangkok, one of the four major cities of Isan, known as the "big four of Isan", and has a population of 466,098 people as of 2021.

items.text: Nakhon Ratchasima is the capital of Nakhon Ratchasima province, the largest city in Northeastern Thailand and the third-largest city in Thailand. It is 250 kilometres northeast of Bangkok, one of the four major cities of Isan, known as the "big four of Isan", and has a population of 466,098 people as of 2021. Wikipedia

items.markdown:
![Nakhon Ratchasima | Korat, Isaan & Khmer | Britannica](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270649-1672-0139-0000-7ce7506b1dd8:8)
Nakhon Ratchasima, widely known as Korat, is `the largest province and the third-largest city in Thailand` , serving as the main gateway to the northeastern region of Isan. It lies about 250 to 260 kilometres northeast of Bangkok and is famous for its rich history, culture, and local hero.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Ratchasima_province) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Ratchasima_province)[[2]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Nakhon%20Ratchasima/580)[[3]](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Nakhon_Ratchasima)[[4]](https://www.centarahotelsresorts.com/centara-life/journal/5-Cool-Things-to-Do-in-Korat-Nakhon-Ratchasima-Thailand)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cB2c25rlGQ&t=1)

Key Places to Visit

- **Khao Yai National Park** : Thailand's oldest national park and a UNESCO World Heritage site featuring mountains, waterfalls, and wildlife.
- **Phimai Historical Park** : An expansive 11th-century stone Khmer temple ruin built in a style similar to Angkor Wat.
- **Thao Suranari Monument** : A central city landmark honoring Ya Mo, the brave local heroine who saved the city in the 19th century.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Nakhon%20Ratchasima/580) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cB2c25rlGQ&t=1)[[2]](https://www.britannica.com/place/Nakhon-Ratchasima)

Travel and Geography

- **Location** : Situated on the western edge of the Khorat Plateau, covering 20,494 square kilometres.
- **Transport** : Easily reached from Bangkok in about 3 to 4 hours by car, bus, or the main northeastern railway line.
- **Best Time to Visit** : During the cooler, dry months between November and March.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Ratchasima_province) [[1]](https://www.asiatours.com/Nakhon-Ratchasima/)[[2]](https://www.agoda.com/hermitage-hotel-resort/hotel/nakhonratchasima-th.html)[[3]](https://www.agoda.com/punn-hotel/hotel/nakhonratchasima-th.html)
